title: gf2-sim library coverage to 90%
description:
Add targeted tests so gf2-sim library line coverage reaches at least 90%.

## Background

Post-exclusion (CLI binaries removed), gf2-sim library coverage is 86.7% — about 176 covered lines short of 90%. The under-covered library modules are `executor/topology.rs` (138 uncov, 79%), `executor/drain.rs` (102 uncov, 44%), `executor/failure.rs` (40 uncov), `frame_sim.rs` (72 uncov, 59%), `stage.rs` (72 uncov, 73%), `graph/mod.rs` (64 uncov, 90%), and `presets/nr_5g.rs` (48 uncov, 92%).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-1: gf2-sim library line coverage is at or above 90.0% under the post-exclusion measurement.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-2: New coverage targets the executor and pipeline modules above and exercises real behaviour (topology/drain/failure paths, frame-sim flow), not contrived line-touching.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-3: All added tests are deterministic and respect the fast-tier discipline: any test driving the simulation runner above the frame/query thresholds in CLAUDE.md carries the required ignore marker.

## Notes

`gf2-sim` is `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`. The executor failure/drain paths benefit from fault-injection style tests; the project already has `executor_failure_modes` and `determinism` test patterns to follow.
